rourke.name: Thomas Rourke
rourke.note: Steady under pressure; reports problems early.

okafor.name: Daniel Okafor
okafor.note: Methodical. Asks hard questions of the engineers.

price.name: Samuel Price
price.note: Team player; defers to the engineers.

moreau.name: Charles Moreau
moreau.note: Cautious. Will not fly what he does not understand.

nakamura.name: Edward Nakamura
nakamura.note: Bold; pushes for more in every flight.

castellano.name: John Castellano
castellano.note: Gregarious; reports late when he thinks he can fix it himself.

oyelaran.name: Michael Oyelaran
oyelaran.note: A steady hand in the simulator; few words.

beckett.name: Walter Beckett
beckett.note: Wrote his thesis on orbital rendezvous.

dumont.name: Eugene Dumont
dumont.note: Wants to fly the lander more than anything.

tanaka.name: Stuart Tanaka
tanaka.note: Geology is his hobby, and it shows.

halloran.name: Peter Halloran
halloran.note: Made captain young. Runs a crew the way he runs a deck: everyone eats before he does.

dengler.name: Martin Dengler
dengler.note: Knows the CSM's propellant lines better than the men who built them.

serrano.name: Miguel Serrano
serrano.note: Took the telescope job nobody else wanted and made it the mission.

cavanagh.name: Sean Cavanagh
cavanagh.note: Quiet, watchful, keeps his own checklists.

ostrowski.name: Gary Ostrowski
ostrowski.note: Watches the crew's bodies as closely as the machines.

lindstrom.name: Erik Lindstrom
lindstrom.note: Argues for one more observation every time.

adeyemi.name: Kunle Adeyemi
adeyemi.note: Fixed more hardware on orbit than the ground expected.

whitfield.name: Dana Whitfield
whitfield.note: Planned the Earth-survey passes down to the second.

gardner.name: William Gardner
gardner.note: Wrote the docking module's alignment procedure himself.

novak.name: Joseph Novak
novak.note: Grounded for years on a heart murmur; cleared at last.

carter.name: Robert Carter
carter.note: Flew the first one down by hand to the lakebed.

ellison.name: Marc Ellison
ellison.note: Flys the approach the way the simulator says and not a knot differently.

vasquez.name: Elena Vásquez
vasquez.note: Keeps the mission timeline in her head and the crew on it.

winters.name: Rachel Winters
winters.note: Won the teacher-in-space seat. Training hard, and loved by the office.

hobbs.name: Charles Hobbs
hobbs.note: Says little and checks everything twice.

nakagawa.name: Ken Nakagawa
nakagawa.note: Runs the satellite deployments like clockwork.

brennan.name: Sarah Brennan
brennan.note: Argues for the telescope like it is a person.

donovan.name: Liam Donovan
donovan.note: Came up through the test wing at Edwards; knows the lakebed.

dunmore.name: Rachel Dunmore
dunmore.note: Joined the year after Challenger, and reads every waiver twice.

arriaga.name: Luis Arriaga
arriaga.note: Built instruments for the telescope before he ever flew.

harker.name: Tom Harker
harker.note: Quiet on the loop, quick on the arm.

okeke.name: Chidi Okeke
okeke.note: Flies the arm and the approach with the same calm.

farrow.name: Ada Farrow
farrow.note: Wrote half of the assembly procedures the station is built from.

delacroix.name: Pierre Delacroix
delacroix.note: Rendezvous and docking are his quiet specialty.

quinn.name: Mary Quinn
quinn.note: Watches the crews’ months aloft more closely than anyone.

hawthorne.name: James Hawthorne
hawthorne.note: Steady on the count, generous in debriefs.

penhallow.name: Grace Penhallow
penhallow.note: Flew the last of the station assembly, and stayed six months.

ibrahim.name: Samir Ibrahim
ibrahim.note: Knows the station’s cooling loops the way other people know their street.

navarro.name: Elena Navarro
navarro.note: Runs the medical experiments, and herself, by the clock.

adler.name: Ruth Adler
adler.note: Trained on the company capsules before they had flown anyone.

osei.name: Kwame Osei
osei.note: Mapped lava tubes on Earth for the Moon that comes after.

ashdown.name: Sam Ashdown
ashdown.note: Plain-spoken, and the steadiest hand in the simulator.

sharma.name: Vikram Sharma
sharma.note: Trusted with the first flight of a new spacecraft.

larsen.name: Mia Larsen
larsen.note: Knows the docking system’s tolerances to the millimetre.

vaughn.name: Theo Vaughn
vaughn.note: Artemis’s commander: unhurried, exact, honest in debriefs.

petrossian.name: Anna Petrossian
petrossian.note: Has been arguing for the south pole since 2009.
